item.title: World Bank partners with Circle, Citi to explore stablecoins for payments
item.description: The initiative builds on the World Bank’s existing blockchain platform, which aims to create more fund traceability for investments in developing countries.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: SOL comes out of Breakpoint 7% higher as Solana exits beta
item.description: Solana’s token reached $75.12 on Tuesday, outpacing Bitcoin and Ether after the network retired the beta label it had used since its 2020 launch.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $240M as CryptoQuant flags bearish market phase
item.description: Bitcoin ETF outflows returned after a one-day pause as CryptoQuant warned that Bitcoin had returned to a bearish market phase.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Ledger hardware implant saga reaches Dubai’s Virgin Megastore
item.description: Two Ledger owners reported losing a combined $604,000 in crypto from hardware wallets they said were purchased at authorized retailer Virgin Megastore in Dubai.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Nvidia board rejects Huang comeback despite record $116B quarter
item.description: Nvidia beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations by 5.6% and issued a stronger-than-expected sales forecast, while its board resisted growing calls for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: CFTC halts some Kalshi Trump mention markets over manipulation concerns
item.description: The CFTC stayed Kalshi’s Trump-related mention markets after raising concerns about manipulation risks, giving the platform until Dec. 11 to defend its contracts.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Maple Finance CEO targets up to $15B in assets by the end of 2027
item.description: Sidney Powell aims to reach $15 billion in assets under management by the end of 2027 as the firm looks to expand into tokenized lending and traditional finance.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Eastern Europe crypto flows fall 7.9% as Ukraine draws $12B in stablecoins
item.description: Chainalysis found that Eastern Europe recorded the steepest decline in crypto activity of any region, while cross-border stablecoin transfers to Ukraine continued amid the ongoing war.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Lighter incident exposes risks beyond withdrawal controls
item.description: Crypto platforms need enforceable limits on every route an API key can use to transfer value, including trades, internal transfers and shared pools.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Adrian Zmudzinski

item.title: Fed’s Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
item.description: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin drops 2.5% as Nvidia stock risks new 5-month lows into Q3 earnings
item.description: Bitcoin price downside sees local lows of $63,269 as Nvidia stock targets $150 as traders brace for volatility over Q3 earnings.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Solana Foundation takes majority interest in crypto data firm CoinGecko
item.description: Solana Foundation now holds a majority interest in CoinGecko, its product chief said, as the crypto data platform explores trading features.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin to $1M by 2030? ‘Almost certainly not,’ says Dragonfly’s Qureshi
item.description: Dragonfly’s Haseeb Qureshi says Bitcoin could reach $400,000 by 2030 but doubts it will return to $100,000 by year-end with the rout in AI stocks weighing on crypto.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: ARK sells $85M in Nvidia shares ahead of chipmaker’s Q3 earnings results
item.description: ARK bought shares in Block, Circle and Coinbase worth about $39.9 million at Monday’s close while selling Nvidia and Solana and Ether staking ETFs.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Revolut plans four blockchain-based funds for private markets, chair says
item.description: Citing a looming liquidity crunch, Martin Gilbert said blockchain could help bring more liquidity to private markets.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

media:content.media:description: bank with revolut logo and token in front

item.title: US senators seek SEC answers on tokenized stock money laundering risks
item.description: Four Democratic senators asked who would be responsible for tokenized shares transferred outside regulated platforms and whether the SEC could freeze or recover those tokens.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF snaps $2.35B outflow streak amid extreme fear
item.description: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF ended 11 sessions of withdrawals totaling $2.35 billion, but CryptoQuant says one day of inflows is too early to signal a recovery.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Bitcoin realized loss metric beats June high as open interest eyes 2-year low
item.description: Bitcoin short-term holders’ onchain spending notched the largest proportion of realized losses since February after BTC/USD dropped to $62,000.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Google says hackers use AI agents to find and exploit software flaws
item.description: Google says attackers are using AI agents to find and exploit software flaws automatically, reducing the time organizations have to apply patches.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: US judge clears brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV case after mistrial
item.description: Judge Jessica Clarke said the transactions did not involve false promises, but the ruling did not determine whether the brothers’ conduct was ethical or violated other laws.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Goldman Sachs reports $1.22B in Ether ETFs as ETHA share count jumps
item.description: Goldman Sachs increased its Ether ETF shares in Q3, bringing its reported holdings to $1.22 billion, while reshuffling its Bitcoin ETF positions.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Ex-Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to $125K Hyperliquid trading scheme
item.description: The former Robinhood engineer used confidential information about upcoming Robinhood token listings to trade on Hyperliquid.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Trezor customer data exposed in 3rd partner breach this year
item.description: Trezor warned an attacker has been able to access customer names, phone numbers and delivery addresses linked to 27,000 orders from one of its shipping providers.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Hackers inject credit card, crypto-stealing malware into 178 major websites
item.description: Ledger and Coinpass were among the businesses whose websites served malware designed to steal visitors’ crypto and credit card details, according to security researchers.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Nvidia shares fall 4% as board reportedly rules out Huang return
item.description: The chipmaker’s board is reportedly focused on investigating Huang’s conduct, even as a petition calling for his reinstatement gathers more than 187,000 signatures.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access
item.description: The Supreme Court refused to hear Custodia Bank’s appeal, meaning a lower court ruling allowing the Fed to reject account applications will stand.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: German lawmakers back crypto freezes outside criminal cases
item.description: Customs authorities could hold “suspicious” assets for 30 days under the bill, with court oversight for extensions and disputed confiscation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Bryan O'Shea

item.title: Binance hack may push institutions to outside custody, FalconX exec says
item.description: FalconX’s Joshua Lim says the Binance hack could push institutions to keep crypto off exchanges and change how large investors trade in 2027.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Bitmine edges toward 5% of ETH supply as treasuries report buys amid market slump
item.description: Strategy, Strive, Bitmine and Cypherpunk disclosed fresh additions to their crypto treasuries, spanning Bitcoin, Ether and Zcash.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar
